title: Bug: Connection atempts when phone in Flight Mode and Bluetooth in ON
body:
When the phone is in Flight mode and the Bluetooth is ON, the device stills tries to connects to the cloud generating error warnings periodically.
The expected behavior should be that in this case the cloud uploads should be paused.

Error message: Unable to do a REST API Upload: Unable to resolve host xxxxx.kerokuapp.com ....
Phone: Google Pixel XL
Android 8.1.0
App version: 20a4313-2017.11.13

comments.body:
@jofrep This does not interfere with proper operation of xDrip as a CGM, does it?
I also get the error when I don't have WiFi coverage because I have not given data access to xDrip.
I think this is the expected behavior.
Would you pleaser close this issue, or explain why this is necessary?
Thanks
